newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India's ONGC crude production falls in October.
newsitem.headline: India's ONGC crude production falls in October.

text.p: India's state Oil and Natural Gas Corp Ltd's total crude oil production for October has fallen by around 10 percent year-on-year, a company official said on Wednesday.
The official said the total crude output from main oil producer ONGC in October was 16.819 million tonnes compared to 18.635 million tonnes a year ago.

He said although the country's largest hydrocarbon producing area, the Bombay High Basin, hiked its output to 1.696 million tonnes of crude, up from 1.628 million tonnes in September, it was still below 1.74 million tonnes produced in October 1995.
However gas output from the Basin, ONGC's main gas producing area, was on the rise.
Natural gas production from the Basin was at 1.1714 trillion cubic metres in October this year, up year-on-year from 1.1096 trillion cubic metres.
The Basin's monthly output of liquid petroleum gas (LPG) similarly rose to 98,104 tonnes this October, up from 94,000 tonnes year-on-year.
